---

DECISION: Apply sizeId to every cascade strategy level, not just strategy 1

REASONING: Ned's explicit rule — 'shouldn't have fallbacks for sizing. If we don't find it, search results will find it [zero results is fine].' Showing wrong-size results is worse than showing fewer results.

PREVIOUS ATTEMPT: sizeId only on strategy 1, falls back to no-size on 2-4 — returned wrong sizes

FINAL: vinted-cascade.ts passes sizeId in params to all strategies. If vinted.lt market is too small for that size, returns 0 results from cascade → acceptable

NOTE: For image search (UUID queries), sizeId is also applied. Accessories (resolveSize returns undefined) naturally skip size filtering across all paths.
